thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: reserved GPU pool "dedicated-east-3" at 98.9% used. Queue depth rising for reserved tenants: AcmeCorp (95% qdepth), NovaHealth (full). Autoscaler attempted 2 scale-ups and failed with 'quota_exceeded'. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reserved-capacity
erez-oncall: I'm on it, joining bridge. @lee-sre @sami-eng-runtime ping
lee-sre: looking at metrics — queue growth started ~2m ago, big burst from AcmeCorp long-running jobs. Eviction logs are patchy, taking a look now.
maria-mlinfra: noisy tenant confirmed — AcmeCorp has multiple long-running beam-gen sessions filling KV caches. Suggest temp cgroup/slots or preempt small-batch sessions.
sami-eng-runtime: autoscaler logs show "quota_exceeded: cannot create more GPUs" and "scale_decision: blocked by region limit". Trying manual fallback to dedicated-burst if available.
erez-oncall: Jordan from CS, any customer-side changes? @jordan-cs
jordan-cs: AcmeCorp reporting they kicked off a big evaluation earlier. Not expected at this scale. I'm on a call with their infra now, requesting immediate pause.
ashley-product: we should enable tenant throttles for reserved pools to protect SLAs for other enterprise tenants.
lee-sre: running quick checks, listing reservations and usage:
```
rbctl pool show dedicated-east-3 --format table
# 64 GPUs total, 64 reserved used, 0 spare
rbctl reservations list --pool dedicated-east-3 | grep AcmeCorp
```
sami-eng-runtime: attempted manual scale: 
```
rbctl pool scale --pool dedicated-east-3 --target-gpus 72
# API error: quota_exceeded: region-gpu limit 64
```
We need fallback plan.
erez-oncall: Plan: 1) Pause AcmeCorp job (CS coordinating) 2) Reroute NovaHealth to fallback pool "dedicated-eu-burst" 3) If pause fails, evict long-running sessions from noisy tenant (eviction-window 60s).
lee-sre: Kicking eviction plan now: `rbctl eviction create --pool dedicated-east-3 --selector tenant=AcmeCorp --policy preempt-long` — starting.
deploy-bot: Eviction job started (job id ej-8921). Logs: evicted 4 sessions, reclaiming 8 GPUs.
maria-mlinfra: also pushing a temporary routing change to lower-cost model for NovaHealth: swap route model gpt-xl-8b-quant -> gpt-large-3b-quant for fallback.
jordan-cs: AcmeCorp confirms they paused the heavy run. :thumbsup:
sami-eng-runtime: Re-routing NovaHealth to dedicated-eu-burst applied. Their queue depth dropped ~70%.
erez-oncall: Monitoring for 10m; will escalate if regressions. Bridge: https://meet.link/bridges/incident-6299991234
ashley-product: Customer impact notes: AcmeCorp saw transient job interruptions; NovaHealth experienced ~350ms increased latency during routing change. We'll need post-incident comms.
lee-sre: metrics now show pool utilization down to 84% after evictions and re-route. Queue length normalizing.
erez-oncall: Closing bridge in 30m unless anything regresses. Follow-ups: request region quota increase and implement hard throttles for reserved tenants. Thanks all.
sami-eng-runtime: Filing tickets: #INC-6299 (quota request) and #TASK-824 (auto tenant throttles + eviction improvements).
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated. Severity downgraded to P3. Event logged.
